item.title: Production Desk 1.5.5
item.description:
Production Desk 1.5.5

  • See available desktop updates and their changelog after your workspace opens. Choose Install Update or Later; postponed updates can be reopened from the menu.
  • Installation requires your choice and a successful save. Finish or cancel open editor dialogs before updating so unfinished drafts stay intact. Ordinary exit never installs an update.
  • Avoid repeated update notices and duplicate installations. Automatic checks stay quiet offline and when update information is invalid.
  • Keep existing portable productions, scripts, original PDFs, schedules, annotations and shots.
